heading: Okanagan Christmas Markets & Holiday Craft Fairs 2026
title: Okanagan Christmas Markets 2026 | Okanagan Roam
description: Every Okanagan Christmas market and holiday craft fair for 2026, town by town: Kelowna, Vernon, Penticton, Lake Country, Oliver, Osoyoos and winery markets.
intro: This guide lists the 2026 Christmas markets and holiday craft fairs across the Okanagan, from November into mid-December: big weekend markets at Prospera Place and the Laurel Packinghouse, small church and school fairs, markets at wineries and cideries, and hands-on workshops where you make your own wreath or ornament. Many are free or by donation, often to the local food bank.
Markets are grouped by area, in date order. Each one shows its town and date. Check the event page for hours before you go.

items.name: A Merry Little Christmas Market
items.text: a curated holiday market inside an executive home in the Upper Mission, with local makers' decor, candles, jewellery, coffee and kids' keepsakes. Two VIP evenings include a glass of wine; the weekend is general admission with timed entry.

items.name: Winter Warm-Up Market
items.text: more than 60 vendors sell handcrafted gifts, artisanal goods, festive treats and one-of-a-kind decorations at the Rotary Centre for the Arts. Admission is by donation.

items.name: Christmas at the Laurel
items.text: a three-day, European-style holiday market in the historic Laurel Packinghouse, with handmade gifts from local artisans and festive treats. Admission by donation to the Food Bank.

items.name: It's Christmas @ the Red Barn
items.text: a two-day holiday market with more than 50 local makers selling clothing, gourmet foods, body products, jewelry and home decor. Free admission; Food Bank donations welcome.

items.name: Delta Grand Holiday Market
items.text: about 100 vendors fill the Delta Hotels Grand Okanagan Resort for a day of festive shopping in a lakeside setting. Admission is by donation.

items.name: Holiday Magic Market
items.text: around 60 local makers take over the Rotary Centre for the Arts. Admission is by donation.

items.name: Downtown Kelowna Winter Street Market & Light Up
items.text: Downtown Kelowna's free kick-off to the holidays fills Stuart Park with a vendor market, family activities and stage performances, then the park's lights are switched on at 5 pm.

items.name: Craft Culture Holiday Market
items.text: Kelowna's largest holiday market fills Prospera Place with more than 200 local crafters and artisans. The market runs all weekend, and admission is $7.

items.name: Christkindl Holiday Market
items.text: a traditional European-style Christmas market in the Laurel Packinghouse, with handmade local gifts, festive treats and hot cider. Admission by donation to the Food Bank.

sections.heading: Kelowna church, school and community fairs

items.name: St. Pius X Community Christmas Bazaar
items.text: a parish Christmas bazaar selling decorated trees, ornaments, lights, wreaths and gifts. A low-key, budget-friendly holiday shopping stop.

items.name: Glenmore Christmas Artisan Fair
items.text: a free Christmas artisan fair at Mountainview Church with local makers, door prizes, a coffee bar and a bake sale.

items.name: Immaculata Annual Christmas Craft Fair
items.text: vendors and artisans, plus a bake sale, children's activities, refreshments and door prizes. Admission is free.

items.name: Canyon Falls Middle School Winter Market
items.text: student makers alongside local artisans and businesses. Admission by donation.

items.name: Ellison Elementary Winter Market
items.text: an evening winter market with 20+ local artisans and food vendors near the airport.

items.name: 18th Annual Christmas Extravaganza
items.text: a two-day Christmas craft and gift market at Rutland Centennial Hall with about 65 local vendors, a bake sale and door prizes.

items.name: Central Okanagan United Church Craft Fair
items.text: a downtown church craft fair on Bernard Avenue with local vendors selling handmade gifts.

items.name: Springvalley Elementary Christmas Craft Market
items.text: crafters, food vendors and photos with Santa.

items.name: Okanagan Golf Club Holiday Market
items.text: a Sunday holiday market at the Okanagan Golf Club clubhouse, home of Table Nineteen.

items.name: East Kelowna Christmas in the Country Market
items.text: more than 70 local artisans, crafters and bakers inside the historic East Kelowna Hall. Entry is a loonie or toonie, and proceeds support the hall.

items.name: Christmas Ornament and Arts/Crafts Show & Sale
items.text: the 5th annual holiday sale at the West Kelowna Yacht Club, with handmade Christmas ornaments, art and crafts from local makers.
items.where: West Kelowna, from Nov 7, two dates

items.name: Wineries for the Holidays on the Scenic Sip Trail
items.text: Lake Country's Scenic Sip wineries each host their own festive experience for one day: holiday markets, Santa photos, fire pits and seasonal food-and-wine pairings. Pay per stop.

items.name: German Christmas Market at Gray Monk
items.text: Gray Monk's 4th annual German-style Christmas market brings 40+ local vendors, German baking, free photos with Santa and lunch at The Lookout. Free entry, with a free parking shuttle from Jack Seaton Park.
items.where: Lake Country, from Nov 28, two dates

items.name: Peachland Artisan Christmas Market
items.text: the Peachland Arts Council's holiday market of handmade goods from local artisans on Beach Avenue.

items.name: Market at Summerhill
items.text: a weekend artisan market of handmade gifts and local products at Summerhill Pyramid Winery, with bookable hands-on workshops. Shop, sip organic wine and take in the view.

items.name: Home for the Holidays at River Stone
items.text: River Stone Estate Winery's holiday afternoon with an artisan market, live music and seasonal activities for all ages.

items.name: Christmas in the Barn Holiday Market at Red Rooster Winery
items.text: Red Rooster's first Christmas market fills the barn with local makers and gift vendors, plus mulled wine and charcuterie. Small entry fee; kids under 12 free.

items.name: Hester Creek Holiday Market
items.text: a free, family-friendly holiday market with local vendors selling handmade gifts, live music and comfort food from the Terrafina kitchen.

items.name: Lumby Holiday Market
items.text: more than 30 local crafters, makers and bakers fill the White Valley Community Centre.

items.name: Christmas Markets at Farmstrong Cider
items.text: dozens of local vendors, festive food and drink and wagon rides on the cidery's farm. Park at the IPE grounds and ride the $5 shuttle, as there's no parking at the cidery.

items.name: Discover Yuletide Fair at Allan Brooks Nature Centre
items.text: a free holiday fair with local makers selling jewellery, ceramics, prints, textiles, woodwork and candles, plus food trucks. A calm, nature-themed alternative to the busy mall.

items.name: Artsolutely Holiday Artisan Market
items.text: the Vernon Community Arts Centre turns into a holiday shop of handmade work by 45+ local artists, with new pieces arriving through the season.

items.name: Shoparama Holiday Gift Sale
items.text: crafters, small home businesses and bakers under one roof at the Vernon Recreation Centre, plus entertainment, door prizes and food trucks. Admission is free.

items.name: Yuletide @ the PTCC
items.text: a three-day holiday market with local artisans, gift vendors and specialty food sellers, plus the kids-only Little Elf Shop where young shoppers can pick out gifts for family. Admission is $3 a day.

items.name: The Hallway Social at the Cannery Trade Centre
items.text: businesses in the Cannery Trade Centre each host guest makers, vintage sellers and food vendors, so the whole building becomes a walkable local shopping day with wine tastings and music. Free to attend.

items.name: Penticton Farmers’ Market 2026
items.text: the market moves indoors to Cherry Lane Mall in November and December, with South Okanagan produce, eggs, honey, baking and preserves.

items.name: Annual Christmas Craft Fair
items.text: two floors of vendors fill the Summerland Community Centre with quality handcrafted gifts. Admission is by donation to the food bank.

items.name: A Textile Christmas Craft Fair
items.text: the South Okanagan Stitchers show and sell handmade textile art and seasonal crafts from eight local makers. Free entry.

items.name: Christmas Faire
items.text: the OSCA Osoyoos Activity Centre hosts a Christmas Faire, a chance to browse seasonal goods and pick up holiday gifts close to home.

items.name: Fire & Ice Holiday Market & Taste of Osoyoos
items.text: Watermark Beach Resort hosts a free holiday market of local makers and treats, while Taste of Osoyoos sends shoppers to six downtown Main Street stops.

items.name: The Last Chance Holiday Market
items.text: handmade gifts from local artisans, specialty foods and festive treats, billed as the last local shopping stop before Christmas. Admission $3 at the door.

items.name: West Bench Holiday Market
items.text: a holiday market of local vendors that raises money for West Bench Elementary's parent council. Entry by donation.

sections.heading: Make it yourself: holiday craft workshops

items.name: Sip & Craft Workshops at See Ya Later Ranch
items.text: evening craft nights in the tasting room, each with charcuterie and a glass of wine, including painting holiday wine glasses, a Yule-log centrepiece and gingerbread cookie decorating. Beginner-friendly, $40–$60.

items.name: Workshop: Holiday Wreath Workshop and Barrel Sampling @ Noble Ridge Vineyard and Winery
items.text: craft your own holiday wreath, then move into the barrel room for a barrel tasting. The cost is $85.

items.name: Christmas Gnome Crafting
items.text: design your own whimsical gnome at Gray Monk. Arrive early for a complimentary glass of wine before you start.

items.name: Holiday Workshops at Ward's Wine Country Kitchen
items.text: a fresh wreath workshop in November and a table centrepiece workshop in December. Supplies, a glass of wine and a cheese plate are included; no experience needed.

items.name: Grinch Tree Workshop at Yellow Dog Brewing
items.text: decorate a small cypress into a whimsical Grinch-style tree to take home, with all decorations provided and a drink included. Also at {event:penticton/grinch-tree-workshop-at-neighbourhood-brewing|Neighbourhood Brewing, Dec 8}.

items.name: Handmade Holiday at the Vernon Library
items.text: a free drop-in afternoon of making handmade holiday gifts and crafts, open to all ages.

items.name: Poinsettia Ornament Workshop
items.text: make a poinsettia ornament to take home or hang on the tree, at Phantom Creek Estates.
